# `array_remove`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
array_remove(array, element)
```

Remove all elements that equal to element from array.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_remove, example 1
> SELECT array_remove(array(1, 2, 3, null, 3), 3);
[1,2,null]
```
